verses: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ

leads.title: Second tablets and ark; Levites set apart; what God requires ↔ The clear proof
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 same element.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/08-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: They were commanded only to serve God sincerely, as hunafa' (pure monotheists), pray and give alms: the upright religion (weight 7.7). Pair score 7.7.

Only in Second tablets and ark; Levites set apart; what God requires: Aaron dies and his son Eleazar becomes priest in his place; Wooden ark made to hold the stone tablets; God's choice of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and what it passes on [divergence between the texts]; Circumcise the foreskin of your heart; God of gods and Lord of lords; Love the stranger, for you were strangers in Egypt; Moses hews a second pair of tablets to replace the broken ones; The prophet neither eats nor drinks for forty days; The family that went down to Egypt numbers seventy persons; The 'uncircumcised' or covered heart [divergence between the texts]; Descendants as numerous as the stars of heaven; The tablets of the testimony are placed inside the ark; and 6 more.

Only in The clear proof: God is pleased with the saved and they are pleased with him; The People of the Book split only after the clear proof (al-bayyina) came to them; A messenger from God recites purified scrolls (suhuf mutahhara) containing upright writings; What God requires: to do justice, love hesed and walk humbly with your God; The reward of the righteous is the gardens of Eden (jannat 'adn) beneath which rivers flow, forever.

Shared motifs, rarest first: What God requires: to do justice, love hesed and walk humbly with your God (weight 7.1). Pair score 7.1.

Only in YHWH's lawsuit with his people; what YHWH requires: Remember what Balak king of Moab plotted and how Balaam son of Beor answered him; God sent Moses, Aaron and Miriam before the people (Miriam named as a leader); God's plea: 'My people, what have I done to you? How have I wearied you? Answer me'; Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression? Thousands of rams and rivers of oil do not please God; God offered the Trust (amana) to the heavens, earth and mountains; they refused and feared it, but man bore it, unjust and ignorant; God summons heaven and earth to the judgment of his people in a covenant lawsuit; God desires a broken spirit, thanksgiving or obedience rather than animal sacrifice.
